tagline: Free GEO audit for AI search

descriptions.short: Free GEO audit: see what AI search reads on your page and what to fix first.
descriptions.medium: An AI-native GEO audit for AI search. See what ChatGPT, Perplexity and AI Overviews read on your page, and exactly what to fix first. Free, no signup.
descriptions.long: GEO.new is a free, AI-native audit of one public page: what AI search and agents can read on it, what they cannot, and what to fix next. It runs 176 checks and scores the page on AI citability, content and E-E-A-T, AI access and rendering, schema and structured data, brand and entity, and platform readiness, with evidence under every row and fixes ordered by measured severity and effort. No signup needed: enter a page URL and run the audit.
